game.name: oxGBC
game.desc: A Game Boy and Game Boy Color emulator written in Rust: sub-instruction CPU timing and a dot-level PPU, validated in CI against Blargg, Mooneye, SameSuite, dmg-acid2, cgb-acid2 and cgb-acid-hell. Gamepad-first UI: a cartridge library with cover art as a shelf, a list or a carousel, save-state slots with previews and play time, rewind, turbo and slow motion, GLSL shaders, colour palettes for mono games, and every button rebindable. Bring your own cartridges.
